  • 顧客の使用状況やパフォーマンスデータを分析し、最適な提案を行うための洞察力がある。

Logs Specialist

Dynatrace is seeking a results-driven Log Management Domain Specialist to serve as the primary domain authority for our Log Management solution. This is a high-impact, domain role designed to drive the successful adoption, consumption, and displacement of legacy log tools. You will partner with our Global Sales organization to demonstrate the unique value of the Dynatrace Grail™ data lakehouse, helping customers transition from high-cost, fragmented logging silos to a unified, AI-powered observability platform.

Core Responsibilities

Domain Expertise:

  • Act as the domain "subject matter expert" (SME) for Logs, staying ahead of industry trends like OpenTelemetry (OTel), log pipelines (Cribl/BindPane), and cloud-native logging (CloudWatch/Stackdriver).
  • Articulate the architectural superiority of Dynatrace Grail—specifically how its schema-on-read and index-less storage solve the "cardinality explosion" of modern logs.

Competitive Execution:

  • Partner with Account Executives/SEs to identify and execute displacement plays against legacy incumbents.
  • Lead high-stakes Proof of Concepts (POCs) that drive Logs consumption that prove ROI by reducing data ingest costs while increasing troubleshooting speed.
  • Build "Economic Value" models that show customers how to optimize their SaaS consumption and maximize their Dynatrace investment.

Solution Architecture:

  • Expertise in architecting resilient, vendor‑neutral log‑ingestion frameworks utilizing Fluentd, Logstash, and OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines, etc.
  • Help customers navigate complex log-routing scenarios, ensuring high-value data is prioritized for analytics while low-value data is archived cost-effectively.

Consumption Advocacy:

  • Identify "consumption bottlenecks" within existing accounts and proactively provide technical guidance to unlock more log data volume and user adoption.
  • Conduct "Best Practice" workshops focused on log-based alerting, DQL (Dynatrace Query Language) proficiency, and dashboarding.

What will help you succeed

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a domain, specialist, pre-sales, professional services, or SRE role, with at least 3 years specifically focused on Log Management or Big Data analytics.
  • Technical Depth: Advanced proficiency in Query Languages (e.g., Splunk SPL, Kusto QL, SQL, or Lucene).
  • Deep understanding of Log Ingestion pipelines and "Telemetry Pipelines" (Cribl, BindPlane, Vector).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Serverless logging patterns.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP logging ecosystems and automation tools like Terraform or Ansible.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate "bits and bytes" into "dollars and cents"—explaining how log management impacts MTTR and operational overhead.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in - Computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands‑on exposure to modern observability pipelines, including Cribl solutions or OpenTelemetry logging specifications.
  • Familiarity with the Cribl ecosystem or OpenTelemetry logging specs.
  • Experience with scripting (Python, Go, or Bash) for log transformation and data cleanup.

Dynatrace’s Data & Analytics organization is building a scalable, AI-ready, self-service data ecosystem and standing up a dedicated Data Governance function to define the standards and practices that make data trustworthy and safe for analytics and AI. We treat governance as an enabler, not a gate, a central hub setting companywide standards while partnering with decentralized data owners and stewards.

This is a foundational hire: an experienced, strategic and collaborative Data Governance Lead to shape the companywide data governance framework. You will define the enterprise standards, processes and operating model for trusted, scalable data and establish the vision and framework for governance. You will partner with engineering to build the platform capabilities that make governance real with reliable data for both analytics and AI, operating within a hub-and-spoke model that sets central standards while decentralized owners, stewards and data product managers apply them.

You will help establish AI-ready data and the model for how data and AI can be used responsibly, including the self-service standards that let people and AI tools consume governed data. You will work hands-on while building the practices that scale the function as it grows. This is a high-impact role focused on building trust in data, driving adoption and supporting enterprise decision-making.

Dynatrace is looking for a Vice President of Public Sector Customer Success to lead our post-sale customer organization across the US Federal, State, Local, and Education (SLED) markets. This is a senior leadership role with full accountability for Customer Success Management, Professional Services, and Technical Support across the Public Sector practice; three functions that must operate in concert to deliver a world-class customer experience in one of the most regulated and complex environments in enterprise software.

This is not a role for someone looking to maintain an existing operation. We are building a deliberate, scalable Public Sector customer organization; one that meets the unique compliance, security, and engagement requirements of government customers while delivering the same standard of excellence we hold across the rest of our business. The VP of Public Sector Customer Success will own that build and be held accountable for its outcomes.

You will report to the Chief Customer Officer and work closely with the SVP of Global Support, VP of Professional Services, and Americas Customer Success leadership to ensure your region operates as a fully integrated, high-performing team.

In addition to full ownership of the Public Sector practice, this role carries direct accountability for non-Public Sector technical support across the Americas ensuring that commercial and enterprise customers in the region receive the same standard of support excellence as their Public Sector counterparts. You are the senior support leader for the Americas in its entirety.

  • Drive post-sale growth and retention by leading Customer Success, Professional Services, and Technical Support teams to deliver a unified, technically excellent, and compliant customer experience across the US Public Sector (FedRAMP) and Americas Commercial segments.

  • Deliver operational excellence and transformation by owning key performance metrics (NRR, GRR, CSAT, MTTR), leveraging AI and Salesforce tooling, and scaling delivery models to consistently hit rigorous targets.

  • Serve as a strategic executive partner and cross-functional advocate, aligning with Sales, Product, Legal, and Compliance to secure renewals, mitigate customer risk, and champion the voice of the customer internally.

  • Cultivate high-performing technical talent by establishing clear career pathways (such as Staff Engineering) and driving a culture of continuous learning, self-help (Knowledge-Centered Support), and rapid incident resolution.

  • Manage rigorous security and compliance boundaries in close partnership with Legal and Security teams to meet strict FedRAMP, access control, audit, and cleared-personnel requirements.

What will help you succeed

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in customer success, professional services, or technical support — with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple post-sale functions
  • Proven track record of leading and integrating Customer Success, Professional Services, and/or Support organizations in a high-growth enterprise SaaS environment
  • Deep experience in the US Public Sector — federal, SLED, or defense — including direct experience managing relationships with government customers at the executive level
  • Experience supporting or operating within FedRAMP-authorized environments — including a working understanding of FedRAMP High, Moderate, and Low impact levels and the compliance obligations they place on customer-facing teams
  • Familiarity with government procurement and contracting frameworks including FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, and IL4/IL5/IL6 requirements as they relate to post-sale customer engagement
  • Experience working within or alongside a FedRAMP authorization boundary — understanding what personnel can and cannot access in a government cloud environment and how to structure delivery accordingly
  • Experience managing cleared personnel requirements and structuring teams to meet US person and security clearance obligations
  • Experience leading professional services delivery in regulated environments — including scoping, SOW development, delivery management, and quality assurance
  • Experience building and scaling customer success programs — including health scoring, QBR programs, adoption frameworks, and renewal management
  • Strong understanding of support operations including workforce management, case management tooling, knowledge management, and SLA governance
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or equivalent enterprise platforms
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, or infrastructure software is a strong asset

Leadership

  • A leader who builds trust quickly, holds high standards, and develops people with genuine intent across multiple disciplines
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and across a matrixed global organization
  • Data-driven — you lead with evidence, not instinct, and you build that expectation across your team
  • Strong executive presence — able to represent Dynatrace credibly at the agency and department level, at the C-suite, and with global leadership peers
  • Collaborative by nature — able to operate as a strong practice leader while functioning as a genuine partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, and the broader Customer organization

Mindset

  • You believe world-class customer experience is a competitive advantage, not a cost center
  • You are as comfortable in the details of a services escalation or a support case as you are in a strategic conversation with a senior government official
  • You hold yourself and your team accountable without creating a culture of fear
  • You understand that Public Sector customers have unique constraints — and you build organizations that meet those constraints without compromising quality or speed

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

  • Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
  • We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
  • Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
  • You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
  • Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation and Rewards

  • The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000. When determining your salary, we consider your experience, skills, education, and work location.
  • Our total compensation package includes unlimited personal time off, an employee stock purchase plan, and a reward system.
  • We also offer medical/dental benefits, and a company matching 401(k) plan for retirement.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We offer competitive compensation, company-sponsored premium benefits, medical, dental, vacation/holidays, company matching 401(k) Plan, etc. Dynatrace is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation, creed, disability status, veteran status, pregnancy, genetic status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If your disability makes it difficult for you to use this site, please contact careers@dynatrace.com. Dynatrace participates in E-Verify, participant information in English and Spanish. Right to work information in English and Spanish. EEO is the Law. To be considered for this position, please upload your resume/CV.

Your role at Dynatrace

As Sr. Partner Sales Manager – Cloud Partners, you will drive the co-sell and channel engagement motion with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP) across APAC, focused on enabling regional sales teams to generate incremental pipeline and software license revenue through the cloud hyperscaler ecosystem.

This is an enablement- and execution-first role: you will build and run joint sales plays with cloud provider field, partner, and specialist teams, embed those plays into the regional Dynatrace sales organization, and ensure local sellers and partner managers know how to identify, position, and close co-sell opportunities. You will act as the connective tissue between global partner strategy and the day-to-day motion of APAC account teams.

You will work closely with cloud partner and sales teams in-region to build joint pipeline, drive marketplace private offer transactions, and scale repeatable sales plays across a diverse and fast-growing set of markets, including Asean, Korea, India, Hong Kong, Taiwan and China.

Selective regional travel will be required to support cloud provider field teams, run enablement sessions, and represent Dynatrace at partner and customer events across APAC.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and scale the co-sell relationship with AWS, Microsoft, and GCP across APAC, translating global cloud alliance strategy into region-specific execution
  • Design, launch, and continuously refine joint sales plays with cloud provider field and specialist teams, aligned to regional priorities and buyer segments
  • Drive enablement for Dynatrace regional sales, SEs, and channel partners to run cloud co-sell motions independently
  • Partner directly with regional and in-country Dynatrace sales leaders and account teams to embed co-sell and marketplace motions into everyday selling activity
  • Drive marketplace private offer adoption and transaction support, working with sales and deal desk to structure and close cloud marketplace deals
  • Build and manage relationships with cloud partner development managers (PDMs), partner sales managers, and specialist teams at the country and regional level
  • Identify and activate net-new pipeline using cloud provider co-sell tools, propensity-to-buy data, and joint account mapping
  • Track, report, and forecast co-sell bookings, pipeline influence, and enablement program adoption/effectiveness across the region
  • Share regional best practices, win wires, and playbook iterations with the global Cloud Alliances team so successful plays can be adapted for other regions
  • Represent Dynatrace at cloud provider partner summits, enablement events, and regional field events across APAC.

What will help you succeed

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 7+ years of experience in cloud alliances, channel sales, partner enablement, or enterprise software sales, with direct exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud ecosystems
  • Experience working across multiple APAC markets and India, with an understanding of the regional partner and buyer landscape
  • Proven experience building and running co-sell sales plays and enablement programs with hyperscaler partners (AWS, Microsoft, GCP)
  • Track record driving bookings and pipeline through cloud marketplace private offers
  • Strong existing relationships with cloud provider partner and field teams across ASEAN and/or India.
  • Demonstrated success enabling and supporting regional sales teams — training sellers, building playbooks, and driving field adoption of partner-sourced motions
  • Experience working cross-functionally with regional sales leadership, channel partners, and deal desk/marketplace operations teams
  • Ability to communicate value clearly to both C-level business stakeholders and technical practitioners across culturally diverse markets
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment spanning multiple countries, time zones, and languages
  • Prior experience in observability, APM, security, or broader software/SaaS solution sales is a plus

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

我々は成長を続け、安定した経営基盤を持つテクノロジー企業です。あなたが、常に革新的な存在として評価される環境があります。そんな環境の中で、ソリューションエンジニアとしてこれまでで最高の仕事に挑戦できることを想像してみてください。

私たちは現在、シニア ソリューションエンジニアを募集しています。アプリケーションやインフラに関する知見を活かしながら、お客様と伴走し、オブザーバビリティやAIOpsソリューションを提案していくポジションです。お客様のビジネスの成長を力強く後押ししていただきます。

お客様のIT戦略やアプリケーション／運用、組織の状況を深く理解したうえで、最適なセールス戦略を描き、Dynatraceのソリューションがどのような価値をもたらすのかを分かりやすくお客様に伝えていただきます。また、Proof of Conceptを通じて、Dynatraceのソリューションが実際の現場でどのように活用できるのかを示す役割も担っていただきます。

さらに、ご自身の知識や経験をチームに共有しながら、強いソリューションエンジニアチームづくりに貢献するとともに、お客様のDXやITモダナイゼーションをリードしていただきます。

Responsibilities

  • セールスチームと連携しながら、最先端の手法を活用して、急成長しているオブザーバビリティ／AIOpsプラットフォームの提案・販売を行います。
  • テクニカルセールスサイクル全体を主体的に担い、Dynatraceビジネスの拡大と成長を推進します。
  • セールスプレゼンテーションや製品デモ、技術評価の支援を通じて専門的な知見を提供し、お客様やパートナーとの商談の創出からクロージングまでを支援します。
  • オブザーバビリティ、AIOps、デジタルエクスペリエンス、ビジネス分析、ログ分析などが、お客様のIT戦略や運用にどのように役立つのか、またそれらが全体のIT環境や業務プロセスにどう組み込まれるのかを分かりやすく提案します。
  • CoEチーム、テクニカルサポートチーム、カスタマーサクセスチームと密に連携しながら業務を進めます。

What will help you succeed

  • ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタント、ソリューションアーキテクト、またはソフトウェア開発者として単一のIT企業において5年以上の経験があり、プロジェクトのリードや顧客対応の実績をお持ちの方
  • 日本のSI企業での勤務経験
  • 顧客のITメンバーやその部長レベルと密接に連携し、信頼できるアドバイザーとして提案やプレゼンテーションを行った経験
  • Java、.NET、PHP、Node.js、Golang、Python などのプログラミング言語および Web アプリケーションアーキテクチャ（NGINX、Apache、Tomcat など）に関する深い理解と実装経験。
  • オブザーバビリティ、クラウドインフラ（AWS、Azure、Google Cloud）、クラウドネイティブアーキテクチャ、Kubernetes、Tanzu、OpenShiftに関する深い理解と実装経験
  • 顧客先への出張が可能な方

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatraceで働くことが好きになる理由

  • Dynatraceは卓越した企業文化の基、優れた成果は評価し、競争力のある報酬を提供します。
  • Dynatraceは市場のリーダーであり、マジッククアドラントのリーダーに16年連続で選ばれています。

  • Dynatrace は完全に自動化されており、当社独自の AI テクノロジーを活用した最先端のソリューションを提供します。

私たちは、競争力のある報酬パッケージ、福利厚生、企業年金制度、そして休暇を提供しています。

私たちは、機会均等の雇用主であり、すべての応募者を歓迎します。Dynatraceは、あなたの多様なバックグラウンド、才能、価値観、アイデア、そして専門知識を求めています。これらの特質が、私たちのグローバルチームをより強く、より経験豊富なものにしています。私たちは、才能ある従業員の多様性に支えられています。

As a Senior Data Analytics Consultant, you’ll work with some of the largest sites on the web across major industries (retail, auto, finance, travel, etc.) and help to answer questions about site performance and user engagement. This Senior role demands a blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and executive-level communication to drive measurable business outcomes through observability data and influence digital transformation.

Dynatrace’s tools generate mountains of data, a lot of which clients don’t know how to make use of…that’s where you come in. You will turn that mountain of data into invaluable insight. As someone who lives and breathes data, analysis, and problem solving, you will help your clients understand the right performance data in the right context. You’ll turn that data into business-altering insight, which allows your client to take the right action to improve overall site performance and user experience that maximizes business outcomes. You will be an expert on Dynatrace and observability, specializing in Digital Experience Monitoring and Business Analytics.

  • You will help clients set a strategy for how they can optimize both their current performance and build performance into their culture. Responsibilities include:

  • Possesses excellent organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills with a keen attention to detail

Most AI developer tools operate without any knowledge of how software actually behaves in production. Dynatrace is in a unique position to change that.

You will own the path that telemetry from AI workloads takes into Dynatrace — from the moment an SDK emits a span in a customer's LLM application, through ingest, validation, and into the data model that powers our AI observability product.

This role sits inside Dynatrace's Engineering organization and works closely with product, design, and the platform teams that power Dynatrace's AI-observability stack.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own OpenTelemetry ingest for AI workloads. Build and maintain the ingest path for OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs emitted by GenAI applications, agents, and frameworks. Ensure it is robust, performant, and faithful to the spec.
  • Test and support integrations across the AI SDLC. Validate that popular AI SDKs, frameworks, and agent runtimes produce telemetry that flows cleanly into Dynatrace. Close the gaps you find — in our ingest, in upstream instrumentation, or in the spec itself.
  • Partner with the OneAgent team to align auto-instrumentation, context propagation, and runtime data collection for AI workloads, so customers get a coherent experience whether they instrument manually or rely on OneAgent.

Propose, review, and drive consensus on semantic conventions for LLM calls, agents, tool use, evaluations, and emerging patterns.   • Prototype quickly, run user feedback cycles, and ship to production
  • Collaborate with product and design to identify which developer problems are most worth solving.

The Lead Platform Engineer, Data is a hands-on engineering and operations role responsible for the reliability, governance, automation, and continuous improvement of a large-scale, Tier 1 enterprise data platform. The role requires deep experience managing Snowflake, dbt, ETL/data integration platforms, and production data services, with strong expertise in platform administration, operational excellence, incident management, and automation. The ideal candidate combines practical platform engineering skills with a systems-thinking mindset to improve reliability, scale, and efficiency while reducing manual effort through automation and modern AI-driven capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Snowflake Platform Administration: Own Snowflake administration end-to-end across development, staging, and production environments, leveraging strong Snowflake and enterprise database administration experience to ensure platform reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency. Manage multiple Snowflake accounts, including account consolidation, migration, and modernization initiatives, while driving warehouse optimization, query tuning, RBAC and Row-Level Security implementation, access automation, and platform monitoring. Serve as the primary escalation point for platform issues and lead adoption of advanced Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and Snowpipe. Hands-on Snowflake administration experience, prior database administration expertise, and SnowPro Administrator certification are required.
  • dbt Administration & Governance: Administer the dbt project and deployment infrastructure - owning project configuration, model architecture standards, environment and job management, test coverage enforcement, documentation requirements, and model promotion workflows across environments. Monitor dbt run health and lineage, configure observability tooling (Elementary or equivalent), and partner with analytics engineers to review and certify models for production use.
  • Data Stack Automation & Operations: Automate the operational layer of the data technology stack - including ETL/ELT tool administration (Fivetran, etc), RBAC and access provisioning via Terraform or scripting, alerting and notification pipelines for data quality and platform health, and CI/CD release workflows for dbt and platform configuration. Reduce manual operational toil by building reusable automation frameworks that make routine platform tasks fast, auditable, and self-service where appropriate.


This is a remote eligible position. Candidates who sit within a 45 mile radius of Boston, MA; Denver, CO; Detroit, MI will be required to work hybrid (2 days per week in office). All candidates will be required to work EST hours.

What will help you succeed

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on data platform experience, with direct ownership of a Snowflake environment at production scale.

Preferred Requirements

  • Deep Snowflake DBA skills: virtual warehouse sizing, auto-suspend and scaling policy configuration, multi-cluster warehouse management, and credit cost governance.
  • Snowflake RBAC design: functional role hierarchy design, privilege grants, service account management, and systematic access provisioning - not one-off manual grants.
  • Row-Level Security implementation using Snowflake row access policies for multi-tenant or restricted datasets.
  • Snowflake feature ownership: Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, External Stages, Data Sharing, and Secure Views in production workloads.
  • Query profiling and optimization: reading query profiles, identifying bottleneck operators, applying clustering keys, and resolving warehouse contention.
  • Deep experience administering dbt project end-to-end - model architecture (staging / intermediate / marts), incremental and snapshot patterns, and environment separation.
  • dbt Cloud or dbt Core deployment administration: job scheduling, environment variable management, run monitoring, failure alerting, and model promotion across dev/staging/prod.
  • Test coverage governance: enforcing schema tests, data tests, and source freshness checks as mandatory gates before production promotion.
  • dbt observability: configuring and maintaining Elementary, or equivalent tooling - including artifact-based monitoring, model health dashboards, and freshness tracking against Snowflake account usage.
  • Experience partnering with analytics engineers to review model design, optimize underperforming models, and maintain lineage and metadata for downstream governance.
  • Platform-level administration of Fivetran or Matillion: connector governance, sync scheduling, schema drift policy, user and environment management, and operational escalation handling.
  • Alerting and notification automation: configuring and owning alerts for pipeline failures, data quality breaches, SLA violations, and Snowflake cost spikes - routed to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or ServiceNow with actionable diagnostic context.
  • CI/CD for the data platform: GitHub Actions or GitLab CI pipelines for dbt, Terraform, and ETL tool configuration with environment promotion gates, automated testing, and rollback on failure.
  • Strong Python and SQL: used for automation scripting, operational tooling, and platform health monitoring, not just pipeline development.
  • Hands-on experience enabling Snowflake Cortex AI features, Cortex Analyst semantic model configuration, Cortex Search index setup, and production use of LLM functions.
  • Experience developing analytics agents on behalf of business stakeholders, connecting Snowflake data to Slack or other collaboration tools via bot APIs, webhooks, or slash commands so users can query data and receive insights in their workflow.
  • Practical experience configuring or fine-tuning LLMs (Cortex, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Azure OpenAI) including prompt engineering, system instruction design, and parameter tuning to improve accuracy on governed data.
  • Ability to design and maintain a semantic data layer, verified views, curated schemas, and structured metadata that grounds LLM-generated outputs in accurate, governed Snowflake data.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core, SnowPro Advanced, or Cortex AI certification.
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen) applied to enterprise data workflows.

  • Exceptional written communication: able to co-author compelling joint value propositions, sales plays, and executive briefing documents that resonate with both LLM provider business development teams and customers

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

  • Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
  • We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
  • Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
  • You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
  • Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation and Rewards

At Dynatrace, total compensation for this role is made up of a strong base salary, a lucrative variable commission structure, and equity.
  • Base Salary Range: $192,000 - $240,000. Your exact offer will be based on your unique experience, skill set, education, and geographic location.
  • Variable Pay: Additional commission tied directly to your success and performance targets.
Beyond your cash compensation, Dynatrace offers a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your life, well-being, and long-term wealth, including:
  • Equity & Financial Future: Eligibility for Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and a company-matched 401(k) program.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited personal time off (PTO) and 4 Dynatrace Wellness Days a year.
  • Health & Wellness: Premium medical and dental benefits.
